scope.excluded: Ignored *-seed.json files are not live sources and were excluded. Other old project folders were not inspected.
scope.method: Vite browser exports window.__presentationDecks; readonly schema/text/path/reference inspection. Gallery and p151 deck/compare/slide routes were exercised in actual Chromium. This is supplementary structure review, not a new visual review of all 1057 rendered pages.

checks.imageKindAlwaysGray: ElementView uses constant #e5e5e5, with no img element or asset source.
checks.textRunsPolicy: Rich-text runs are the rendered string; fallback text was not concatenated to runs.
checks.pathSampling: All path point counts/bounds were examined; 2/3/4/6-point geometry dominates. Largest 362-point path is known radial diagram p174/s04-04. Shortest complex path candidate p055/s02-04 is a circular diagram arc. Source files have no contour/glyph tracing machinery.

confirmedIssues.status: resolved in latest actual registry snapshot; see finalResolution
confirmedIssues.description: 234 elements are string object keys, replacing text objects. Renderer receives invalid element data and produces empty elements.

confirmedIssues.status: resolved in latest actual registry snapshot; see finalResolution
confirmedIssues.description: Installed Lucide lacks Instagram and Facebook; current renderer silently falls back to Circle.

confirmedIssues.status: resolved in latest actual registry snapshot; see finalResolution
confirmedIssues.description: p069/s02-06 quote is visibly italic in native source, but italic:true is not a renderer-supported field. Use fontStyle italic plus actually loaded DM Sans italic font face.

nonIssueObservations.interpretation: 56 empty text and 44 empty chip entries include intentionally blank form rows, decorative chips, unused chart-axis label slots, and titles removed when the original crop is blank. Count alone is not a defect.
originalSpellingPreserved: p020/s05-02 We Porpose The Best Service
nonIssueObservations.thinLineInterpretation: Largest thin-line clusters inspected are chart axes/grid lines, subtle background grids, and logo clearance guides. No sampled cluster was confirmed to substitute fake bars for unreadable text.

architecture.reusablePrimitives: model.ts typed Deck/Slide/Element with common T/B/C/I/L/IC/P adapters, shared SlideCanvas/ElementView, shared chart/table/path/icon/ChipLabel rendering. Deck data is independent from the renderer.
architecture.SOLIDAssessment: Layout data, coordinate adaptation, rendering, and navigation have separate responsibilities, and deck modules depend on the shared element model. This is an observed architecture assessment, not a formal proof of all SOLID properties. ElementView central kind switch must be updated for a new primitive; monolithic deck modules remain a maintainability limitation.
architecture.gallery: 47 active links use independent ScaledSlide thumbnails and deck pages.
architecture.comparison: #/compare/:deck uses source images beside independent implementation canvases; source img is outside article.
architecture.unusedSheetHelpers: ReferenceBoard/ScaledReferenceBoard exist in ui.tsx but are not imported/used by App active routes. The actual deck/slide/compare results are separate pages, not reconstructed sheets.
architecture.runtimeSchemaRisk: JSON type assertions allow malformed data to pass TypeScript; runtime/schema validation is needed in verify/render.

finalResolution.method: Actual Chromium Vite window.__presentationDecks snapshot, read-only validation of all active elements/icons/IDs/coordinates/kinds/keys and existing references. Text/path heuristics and previous targeted source/image evidence reused.

initialConfirmedIssuesResolved.p026ObjectKeyStringSpread: All live element entries are now objects; malformed=0.
initialConfirmedIssuesResolved.unavailableBrandLucideIcons: All 1692 live icon elements resolve to installed lucide-react exports.
initialConfirmedIssuesResolved.p069QuoteItalic: p069/s02-06 element2 now has fontStyle:italic, font DM Sans; src/index.css line25 imports wght-italic.css.

finalResolution.laterUnsupportedFieldsResolved: The intervening live unsupported pie/leading/stroke/alt fields and unavailable brand names are absent from the current schema check.
finalResolution.emptyTextInterpretation: 101 candidates are mostly intentional form fields, unused chart labels and omitted headings for partial reference crops; not claimed as 101 defects. Previous targeted review remains valid.
finalResolution.limitations: Not a proof that all prose exactly transcribes unreadable references or that all native geometry is exact; final individual production visual review is tracked separately.
